 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/038d9769ac0d878db61269d2fceac537129b4ccf534a308b32645accbc18a362.png]
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic: No two opposite faces are adjacent to each other.**

Let's find which number is faced opposite to face having '3'.

We are taking both dice figures (1) & (2) together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d59d486a6cfeac1dc807c0c0da5e9ba9ef4e0c5e4e07e2b17dad22b4be519465.png] 

Here, 5 and 2 are common in both dice and 6 is opposite to 1.

Now, we are taking dice figures (2) & (3) together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8bdf22972499d5771ba8b3b676e8032ad061407ce8420c416db98fe1abb2c5e.png] 

Here, 1 and 2 are common in both dice and 5 is opposite to 4.

**Opposite pairs:**

6 ⇔ 1

5 ⇔ 4

3 ⇔ 2

Clearly, 2 faces opposite of 3.

Hence, the correct answer is **"2".**

In the second Dice and third dice, 

Two faces are common i.e , 2, 5.

As 5 and 2 are the common faces on 2nd and 3rd dice, it is clear that 1 is opposite to 6.

The top number will be opposite to each other.

This means 1 will be opposite to 6 and vice-versa.

Hence, the correct answer is "1".

Hence, Option (1) is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dices are of two types :**

 
• **Standard Dice**
 
• **Non-Standard Dice.**

 
• **Dice has:-**

 
• **faces = 6**
 
• **sides = 12**
 
• **corners = 8**

Two opposite faces are never seen together.

Adjacent faces are never opposite to each other.

When two positions of the same dice are given with one face as the common:

1. We take the common letter and move either in a Clockwise or Anti-clockwise direction.

2. The faces that come in this process are opposite each other in the same order.
